mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS channelId, a.merchant_id AS merchantId, c.game_code AS gameCode, IFNULL(SUM(c.bet), 0) AS bets, IFNULL(SUM(IF(c.pay_out > 0, c.pay_out, 0)), 0) AS payout, IFNULL(SUM(c.pay_out - c.bet), 0) AS playerWl, IFNULL(SUM(c.bet - c.pay_out), 0) AS platformWl FROM mms_channel a LEFT JOIN lms_coin_record c ON a.id = c.channel_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.id = #{channelId} AND c.expand_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND c.user_id >= 10000 AND c.tag = #{tag} GROUP BY a.id, c.game_code

SELECT a.id AS merchantId, IFNULL(SUM(d.bet), 0) AS bets, IFNULL(SUM(IF(d.pay_out > 0, d.pay_out, 0)), 0) AS payout, IFNULL(SUM(d.pay_out - d.bet), 0) AS playerWl, IFNULL(SUM(d.bet - d.pay_out), 0) AS platformWl FROM mms_merchant a LEFT JOIN mms_channel b ON a.id = b.merchant_id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ums_user c ON b.id = c.channel_id LEFT JOIN lms_coin_record d ON c.id = d.user_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND d.user_id >= 10000 AND d.tag = #{tag} GROUP BY a.id
